'''Z0-0M''', also known as '''Zeeyo Ohm''', previously '''[[The Shroud (Human)|the Shroud]]''', was a [[Gender/Legends|feminine]] [[IR-9X Replicator Droid|replicator droid]] who was active during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]].

==Biography==
[[File:HK55_and_Z00M.jpg|thumb|left|250px|Z0-0M fights alongside HK-55.]]
The [[Droid/Legends|droid]] known as Z0-0M was activated at some point before the end of the [[Great Galactic War|Galactic War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Old Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]]. Annoyed by the inferiority of her master, she [[Death/Legends|killed]] them and became the criminal [[Spy/Legends|spy]] known as "the Shroud," using actors to play her role while she was safe at her base. Constantly being defeated by [[Alliance Commander|the Commander]], she wanted to destroy their base on [[Odessen]]. She had the droid [[HK-55]] captured so she could copy his memories into a replica, and use its info to send her current puppet to destroy the [[Eternal Alliance|Alliance]] base. Attempting to wipe HK-55's memory, she erased her own, becoming a friendly and innocent droid with no memory of her crimes. Greeting HK, she helped free him and aided him in escaping, trying to stop the Shroud from destroying the Outlander.

[[File:Z0-0M_and_HK-55.jpg|thumb|right|250px|HK-55 uncovers Z0-0M's real identity.]]
She and HK, through a series of [[Escape from the Coil|battles and encounters]], eventually made their way to Odessen. There, they stopped the Shroud, who turned out to be [[The Shroud (impersonator)|one of the many actors]] hired by Z0-0M during her time as the real Shroud, before he could detonate [[Bomb/Legends|bombs]] placed around the [[Alliance base|Alliance Base]]. After HK dealt with the impostor, he spoke with Z0-0M about her future moments before [[Lana Beniko]], [[Theron Shan]], and the Commander arrived to find two unknown individuals with HK-55 in their War Room. He expressed fatigue and promised to explain the situation.<ref name="KOTFE17" />

==Behind the scenes==
Z0-0M was portrayed by [[Cristina Valenzuela]] in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Knights of the Fallen Empire]]''.
